question: Pole P is to the west of pole T and north of pole R. Pole Q is to the west of pole R and north of pole W. What is the position of pole R with respect to pole T?
solution:
**Given:**

Four poles are given: PTRQ and W

**Concept:**

Directions conventions:

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c49320849eedd4b755d0994c530c615beb8b94d3a35bcd5126ab39efc8f9478.png] **

**Explanation:**

Diagram according to the given information:

 
• Pole P is to the west of pole T and north of pole R

 
 
• ​​​
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fb6ef562d1c4d7008009fa407430c2d9954c8931977b6823d87eeee0bb2b586.png] 
 
 
 
• Pole Q is to the west of pole R and north of pole W
 
 
• ​
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/470af91ccb0ab56a8af63066be665005862871646eaf3fbfdc378178282b8467.png] 
 
 
 
• position of pole R with respect to pole T
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eaccb75038f6c6ce427fb9f86b177816c1809ae2bde7624d2c04726a6a6df1e.png] 
 
 

Thus, the South-west is the position of pole R with respect to pole T

Hence, the correct answer is '**South-west'.**
